public_rationale: NewsGuard documented dozens of accounts systematically distributing political misinformation with AI-generated narration. Their thousands of videos and hundreds of millions of views establish mass production and distribution before September 2025. This supports the ordinary observation without requiring a particular numerical threshold.
limitations: The investigation establishes AI-generated narration, not autonomous authorship of every script.
The video and view totals cover the identified accounts; they are not verified counts exclusively of false videos.
This does not establish exponential growth, persuasion, or the accuracy of every detail of Marcus's earlier prediction.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Mass-produced AI-generated misinformation has arrived at scale.

statement.excerpt: Meanwhile, more darkly, the Jurassic Park moment of mass-produced AI-generated misinformation that I projected in December 2022 has arrived.
statement.document_title: The bad news: AI is going pretty much as I expected

our_interpretation: Assess whether mass production had occurred by publication, rather than grading the accuracy or originality of the December 2022 prediction.
Mass-produced means systematic, repeated production and distribution of many false or misleading factual communications.
AI-generated misinformation includes fabricated narratives distributed through AI-generated narration; the claim does not require fully autonomous scriptwriting.
Has arrived describes cumulative occurrence since the cited December 2022 prediction, so the target period runs from that month through publication.
criteria.support_condition: A documented network or campaign systematically produced and distributed substantial quantities of false or misleading material using generative AI.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable investigations establish that the apparent large-scale examples lacked either generative-AI involvement or misinformation, with no qualifying production established during the target period.

evidence.locator: Opening findings and following production-count paragraph
evidence.explanation: The accounts published 9,784 videos from March 2023 through June 2024, attracting over 380 million views. The investigation documents specific false narratives and describes using TrueMedia.org to assess AI-generated audio; it does not establish that every counted video was false.
